mods.name: Cosmere
mods.description: Cosmere is a library mod, meant to be used with it's modules that add features from Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere universe.

releases.notes:
Cosmere `0.8.115` — released as **alpha** from `2a21b1f3`.

### Changes

- [Project] fix the bad auto merge
- [Surgebinding] Ignore off-hand right clicks so surges don't charge twice
- [Project] Publish runs datagen and game tests before uploading
- [Tools/Armor] Use EnumMaps so datagen tag order is consistent
- [Sandmastery] Introductory 'cutscene' added, also block model changes
- [Cosmere] Give kinetic investiture a vibration frequency, closes #207
- [Allomancy] Coin pouch screen only draws its background once
- [Cosmere] Tag uncraftable vanilla metal items and blocks as containing metal
- [Cosmere] Only send the Patchouli missing message once, closes #232
- [Cosmere][Surgebinding] Common ore tags for metal and gem ores, closes #233
- [Allomancy] Fix coin pouch crash on open, closes #234
- [Cosmere] Metalworking Table gives villagers the metal trader job, closes #237
- [Project] game tests setup
- [Project] ignore runGameTests folder
- [Project] Backport GitHub publish workflow support from 1.21.1
- [Allomancy] Steelsight obstruction uses the contains_aluminum tag instead of hardcoded aluminum tags
- [Tools/Armor] Backport the derived tags from 1.21.1 branch
- [Tools/Armor] Pushed datagened files this time
- [Tools/Armor] Fixed armor tags
- [API][Allomancy] Moved 'contains_metal' tag calculation into cosmere api in the form of a generic derived tag handler
- [Cosmere] Bump dynamickeybinds to fix a bug
- [Sandmastery] Trial system... is so very overcomplicated.. why did I do this
- [Sandmastery] Hitbox based dripper detection
- [Sandmastery] Gilded variants of the sandstone
- [Sandmastery] Sand jars can now be used as a stable sand-based light source by dripping water on them
- [Sandmastery] Sand now glows before discharging when touched by water
- [Cosmere][Sandmastery] More sandstone variant stuff (added it all this time)
- [Cosmere][Sandmastery] More sandstone variant stuff
- [Sandmastery] Added taldain variants of sandstone
- [Sandmastery] beginning of Diem of Sand progression (non-canon for gameplay reasons)
- [Dependency] Bump dynamic keybinds version
- [Project] Move client-only dynamic keybind code into client-only class
- [Project] Added DynamicKeybinds as optional dependency to reduce keybind clutter
- Add 1.21.1 to issue template
- [Sandmastery] Sand Jar + Sand layer no longer = Infinite Sand Jars
- [Sandmastery] Sand pouch initial pass & more minor fixes
- [Sandmastery] Small initial pass fixes, more coming soon:tm:
- [Sandmastery] Brought in StarFox's retexture into the project
- [Project] generic inventory ui image generating tool
- [Feruchemy] Fix stack overflow when killing mobs while tapping chromium, fixes #231
- [Cosmere] Fix crash on second world load when Allomancy isn't installed, #230
- [Cosmere] Released 0.8.114, build number now 115
